purpose: Make the existing canonical SkillMemory model consumer-visible and artist-correctable through the normal Song/learning experience: show what N0TE currently believes about named skills, the evidence/source posture behind each latest assessment, allow bounded artist-declared skill state and explicit correction without deleting history, and preserve the rule that N0TE-assessed real-work mastery must be backed by actual closed-Session evidence.

lineage.outcome: The artist can see and correct N0TE's model of what they can do, so teaching and assistance can become grounded in durable real-work evidence instead of a hidden backend ledger.

why_now: REQ-SCOPE-123 explicitly records the Skill Model foundation as implemented while contextual teaching presentation and consumer acceptance remain downstream. SkillMemory already enforces append-only assessment history, real-work Session evidence, assistance tracking, zero-assistance INDEPENDENT state and artist correction. The highest-leverage missing seam is therefore consumer reachability and authority, not another Skill store.
instead_of: First-class reference objects are not selected because live N0TE2 has no persistent Reference model; that would require a new subsystem rather than exposing an existing required foundation.
Full loudness-aware A/B remains unselected because there is still no truthful loudness-analysis/normalization substrate.
Musical derivation remains unselected because the clean-room destination lacks an audio-analysis engine.
Another Activity/Version adjacency increment is not selected because the recent Song continuity loop is already consumer-reachable and marginal leverage is lower.
Another DAW chassis increment is not selected because the Skill Model is host-independent and directly advances N0TE's required expert-teacher role.

legacy_rejections: automatic mastery promotion from chat or scratch
raw internal skill assessment IDs in browser authority

completion_proof: the normal consumer Song/learning surface can list the current state of every recorded skill with artist-facing level, source/evidence posture and assistance truth without exposing internal assessment IDs or evidence IDs
an artist can explicitly declare a named skill state through bounded one-shot authority; UNKNOWN is not available as a declaration because canonical SkillMemory reserves UNKNOWN for correction
an artist can explicitly correct an existing named skill to any canonical level including UNKNOWN, with a required human reason, without deleting or rewriting prior assessments
correction authority binds the exact skill and rendered latest assessment state so a stale page cannot overwrite a newer assessment silently
INDEPENDENT can be artist-declared/corrected only with zero assistance, and UI copy explains the meaning rather than laundering assisted work into independence
N0TE-assessed/observed PRACTICED/APPLIED/INDEPENDENT remains unavailable from this consumer action path and still requires canonical closed-Session real-work evidence
each new assessment creates canonical SKILL_ASSESSED Activity without mutating Song Version/approval/material, Session history, Learning episodes, Focus, Operations, DAWs or providers
quit/relaunch preserves assessment history and current state
authored HTTP/security/stale-state/invariant/restart proof remains separate from executed evidence; absent hosted execution is UNOBSERVED
non_scope: DO IT/WITH ME/SHOW ME interaction modes
global Skill dashboard outside the bounded Song learning surface
next_selection_rule: After this increment lands or blocks, globally reselect. Compare contextual teaching modes, Learning change-consequence-decision reachability, references, fuller Compare/A-B, Creative Studio, audio-analysis substrate, DAW/OPS and other portfolio outcomes.
